_comment: R55 (sampled schema), 2026-09-24, Claude Opus 5.5: tests/gold/text_gold.json with its predicates mapped by a fixed
rule to the automatic arm's proposed schema, before any extraction on it; each triple keeps its labels in `labelled_as`.

Mapping: CAUSES_FAILURE -> not expressible (3); EXHIBITS_FAILURE -> HAS_DEFECT (21); HAS_DEFECT -> HAS_DEFECT (42); IMPEDES_ASSEMBLY_OF -> HAS_ASSEMBLY_ISSUE (8); PART_OF -> PART_OF (22). Not expressible triples can only be missed.
Question Cypher follows the proposed plan (PART_OF, Component) and schema; expected answers unchanged.

questions.question: Which suppliers provide the drawer rails of the Helsingborg Dresser? (domain graph only)
Which suppliers are behind the drawer rails that Helsingborg Dresser reviews report as defective? (text graph to domain graph to supplier)
Which products do reviews report as wobbling?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(:Entity)-[:HAS_DEFECT]->(f:Entity) WHERE any(n IN [f.name] + coalesce(f.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'wobbl') MATCH (c)-[:PART_OF]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name

questions.question: Which products are reported with misaligned pre-drilled holes?
questions.cypher: MATCH (h:Entity {type: 'Component'})-[f:HAS_DEFECT]->(d:Entity {type: 'Defect'}) WHERE any(n IN [h.name] + coalesce(h.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'hole') AND any(n IN [d.name] + coalesce(d.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'align' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'line up') MATCH (:Chunk {chunk_id: f.chunk_id})-[:PART_OF]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name

questions.question: Which products are reported to squeak or creak?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(:Entity)-[:HAS_DEFECT]->(f:Entity) WHERE any(n IN [f.name] + coalesce(f.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'squeak' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'creak') MATCH (c)-[:PART_OF]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name
